what: Inside the big red CTA plate at the bottom of the screen, three 0.5px borders are laid. They turn on from the plate edge at 1.5s intervals (0→1 in place for half of 3s), then shrink inward 24px and vanish for the remaining half, repeating endlessly (curve .45,.25,0,.95). On hover, the playback speed of the three borders doubles over .45s with cubic deceleration and the border color changes to the accent color in .2s. The plate background and text color changes belong to the using side’s css. On leave, it returns to normal speed over the same length.

options.dur: Length of one revolution (sec), default 3 — between borders is half of that
options.rings: Border count, default 3 — data-fx-part="ring" If you set a child directly, it uses that
options.in: Distance to pinch inward (px), default 24 (original margin 16 × 1.5)
options.ramp: Duration (s) for changing speed, default .45 — 0 means instant

use: Your one-line contact here
note: Devices with no pointer only pulse. With reduced motion set, the border is hidden
